title: Density-aware contrast and inline form wireframes
body:
Purpose:
This doc captures a lightweight accessibility audit and wireframe notes for two related UI efforts: (1) density-aware contrast modes (regular / compact / high-contrast) across the console, and (2) a set of inline/compact form patterns for tables, modals, and the routing rules editor. Goal is to produce a minimal set of tokens, interaction rules, and backlog grooming items so engineering and design can pick up an implementation slice for 2026 Q2.

Scope & constraints:
- Surface areas: model list & row actions, routing rules editor, small edit modals, compact create-form flows in dedicated and hosted views.
- Devices: desktop primary, but must behave for narrow laptop widths (>= 1024px).
- Support a user-toggle for High Contrast mode (HC) plus an automatic density adjustment setting for users with larger default font sizes.
- Must not regress existing keyboard flows or screen reader semantics.

Key findings from quick pass (heuristic + contrast checks):
1) Token collision at compact density: several neutral/secondary text tokens fall below 4.5:1 when rendered at the smallest compact body size (12px). Affected: table row meta, inline hints, timestamp chips.
2) Inline form affordances: edit-in-place fields in table rows lack sufficiently large focus outlines at compact density — the stroke is 1px and is visually lost on darker backgrounds.
3) Action buttons in compact toolbars: primary action remains ok, but secondary ghost buttons (icon-only) do not meet 3:1 for disabled states versus background in HC mode.
4) Modal stacked inputs: when modal width shrinks, placeholder and label contrast drops; persistent inline validation messages overlap visually with helper text when density is compact.
5) Screen reader flow: switching to HC should not change DOM order — inject via CSS tokens and avoid reordering elements.

Wireframe writeups (high-level, skip-by-skip):
A) Compact Table with Inline Edits (desktop, density=compact)
- Layout: 8px vertical gap between rows, reduced padding to 8/12.
- Inline text field: min tap target 32x32, placeholder color uses token text-muted-compact (updated).
- Focus state: 2px semi-opaque outline using token focus-contrast (calculated to have >=4.5:1 with background).
- Error/validation: red-400 background subtler, use icon + sr-only live region for new inline errors.
- ARIA: row-level edit button has aria-controls to the inline input, role=\"group\" for the editable cell.

B) Modal: Compact Create Rule (narrow)
- Header remains persistent; body switches from 2-column -> single column at <= 980px.
- Labels condensed: small-cap label tokens are allowed but body text must not drop below 13px in HC mode.
- Helper text: moved below field and visually separated by 6px; validation lives below helper text and includes aria-live=\"polite\".

C) High Contrast Mode Toggle (user setting + temporary keyboard shortcut)
- Toggle location: User menu (top-right) + keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+H) for power users.
- Implementation: do not swap tokens client-side; toggle flips a high-contrast CSS variables set.
- Persist: stored in profile and local storage for non-authed flows.

Accessibility specifics & token proposals:
- Introduce tokens: text-compact (for smallest body), text-compact-strong, focus-contrast, icon-contrasted, disabled-ghost-contrast.
- Contrast floor: require 4.5:1 for body text at all densities; for secondary metadata at compact density enforce 3.5:1 with design exception only after product signoff.
- Focus outline: prefer 2px solid token (not box-shadow) at compact density to avoid pixel-bleed on subpixel rendering.
- Icon-only buttons: add additional radial background on hover/focus in compact view to increase hit contrast.

Keyboard and screen reader flows (notes for dev):
- Inline edit: tab moves to row action -> activate edit -> focus to first input in cell with sr-only instruction \"editing cell: <column name>\". Escape cancels and returns focus to row action.
- Modals: focus trap unchanged; on enter validation runs but focus moves to first invalid field. Use aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing to the validation text.
- HC mode announcement: when user toggles HC, trigger a polite live region: \"High contrast mode enabled\".

Edge cases observed during pass:
- System text scaling: when OS scaling >125%, compact density becomes equivalent to regular and some tokens become oversized. Solution: map density purely to user pref, not to rem scaling.
- Inverse themes: dark mode + HC yields washed icons; icons need an explicit HC variant (svg fill override).

Backlog grooming: prioritized items (RICE-light):
1) Token audit & token set for compact + HC (priority P0, owner: design-engineering, est: 3).
2) Compact focus outline update across table and inline inputs (P0, owner: eng-console, est: 2).
3) Icon-only button background pattern when compact (P1, owner: eng-console, est: 2).
4) Modal helper/validation separation rule + small-wireframes for narrow widths (P1, owner: product-design, est: 1).
5) HC toggle + persistence + live-region copy (P2, owner: frontend infra, est: 1).
6) Accessibility QA checklist and automated axe rule additions for CI (P0, owner: sdeqa, est: 4).

Design/implementation notes:
- Start with token changes (safe small set) and a single example page: Model list -> inline edits -> run visual diff.
- Keep changes feature-flagged behind `compact-a11y` so we can roll back if regressions appear.
- Avoid changing DOM structure; prefer CSS tokens and small attribute flags to adjust density.
- Add unit/storybook stories for each pattern at three densities and print snapshots for Percy/backstop.

Open questions for next sync (design + eng + sdeqa):
- Do we accept 3.5:1 as floor for metadata at compact density? tradeoff: visual hierarchy vs strict a11y.
- HC icon set: do we ship hue-adjusted svgs or overlay fills? perf implications.
- Keyboard shortcut for HC: acceptable security posture? (shortcut collisions)

Action items (owners assigned):
- Maya: draft token PR with 6 proposed tokens and token usage doc (due 2026-03-12).
- Liam: prototype compact table wireframe in Figma and export dev-ready specs (due 2026-03-18).
- Sofia: add automated axe checks and update CI rules (PR scaffold by 2026-03-22).
- Ethan: create feature flag and apply to model-list route for quick smoke tests (due 2026-03-25).

Appendix: quick checklist for reviewers:
- Does every changed token have an example at all three densities?
- Are all focus states 2px or larger at compact density?
- Do icon-only buttons have a minimum contrast on hover?
- Are live regions present for inline validation?

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally pragmatic: the goal is to unblock a small engineering slice that meaningfully improves accessibility for compact and HC users without a full redesign. Feedback and concerns collected in the linked JIRA ticket (UX-789).
